title: Skills carry their files and name
rule: Every skill folder holds SKILL.md and evals.md, and the frontmatter name equals the folder name.
fix: Add the missing file, or rename the folder or the frontmatter name so they match.
example: skill "alpha" is missing evals.md. Hint: add it.

title: Agents and commands declare their metadata
rule: Every agent file declares a frontmatter name equal to its filename, and every command file declares a description.
fix: Rename the file or the frontmatter name so they match, or add the description line.
example: agent "bot": frontmatter name "other" must equal the filename. Hint: rename one to match the other.

title: Hook references resolve to files
rule: hooks.json holds valid JSON, and each hook file it names exists.
fix: Fix the JSON, add the missing hook file, or remove the reference.
example: hooks.json references missing hook file "gone.mjs". Hint: add the file or drop the reference.

title: Marketplace source points at a plugin
rule: Each marketplace plugin source holds a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest.
fix: Add the manifest, or correct the source path.
example: marketplace plugin "p": source "nowhere" has no .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Hint: add the manifest or fix the source.

title: Doc counts match the real inventory
rule: README.md and docs/development.md state the true number of skills, agents, hooks and commands.
fix: Write the real count as digits, for example 3 skills.
example: README.md says "3 skills", which is not the actual count of 1. Hint: change it to "1 skills".
mistake: Documentation that drifts from the repo

title: Indexes and citations match the files
rule: Documents, indexes and skill prose agree with the files, and prose avoids the phrases the writing rules ban.
fix: Add the missing row, correct the cited name or path, or reword the banned phrase.
example: skill "alpha" is not documented in docs/skill-graph.md. Hint: add a row for it.

title: Eval measure keyed on a skill heading
rule: Eval measures should not key on a word that also heads the skill, or they match failing runs.
fix: Rename the heading or the measure term so the two differ.
example: alpha/evals.md:7: measure "heading one" must not also appear in SKILL.md heading "heading one", or it may match a failing run. Hint: rename one of them.
mistake: A check that cannot fail

title: zanity config stays at its strictest
rule: zanity.toml selects every rule, disables only two test-file rules and excludes only fixture folders.
fix: Restore the strict setting and fix the findings in code.
example: zanity.toml must keep select = ["all"] under [rules]. Hint: restore it and fix the findings in code.
mistake: Loosening the rule, not fixing the code

title: Skills and agents state their purpose
rule: Every skill and agent has a non-empty frontmatter description.
fix: Add a description line that says what it does and when to use it.
example: skill "alpha" has no frontmatter description. Hint: add a "description:" line saying what it does and when to use it.

title: Eval scenarios exist with unique ids
rule: Every evals.md has at least one scenario row, and no scenario id repeats.
fix: Add a scenario row, or give the repeated id the next unused number.
example: alpha/evals.md repeats scenario id 1. Hint: give the newer row the next unused number, since ids stay stable.
mistake: A gate that passes on nothing

title: Documented script paths resolve
rule: Each scripts/ path that a document names exists, and a skill script it names is executable.
fix: Fix the path, restore the script, or run chmod +x and commit the mode.
example: docs/notes.md names scripts/gone.sh, which exists under no skill and not in scripts/ or plugin/scripts/. Hint: fix the path or restore the script.

title: Every reference has a reader
rule: Each reference file is read by at least one skill, agent or command.
fix: Link the reference from the skill that needs it, or delete it.
example: reference "lonely.md" is read by no skill, agent or command. Hint: link it from the skill that needs it, or delete it.

title: Every hook has its own test
rule: Each hook file has a colocated .test.mjs file.
fix: Add a test that runs the hook and asserts its decision.
example: hook "h.mjs" has no colocated h.test.mjs. Hint: add a test that runs the hook and asserts its decision.

title: Every hook is documented
rule: docs/skill-graph.md names every hook file.
fix: Add a row that names the hook and says what it does.
example: hook "h.mjs" is not documented in docs/skill-graph.md. Hint: add a row naming it and what it does.

title: Marketplace manifest pins no version
rule: The marketplace manifest carries no version field, so every commit is a new version.
fix: Delete the version field.
example: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json carries a version. A pinned version freezes installed copies until someone changes it. Hint: delete the "version" field; users then get every commit.
mistake: A change that never reaches installs

title: Every environment variable is documented
rule: Each environment variable that code reads, with the repo prefix, appears in some markdown file.
fix: Add the variable to the knobs table in docs/onboarding.md.
example: scripts/x.ts reads GATED_DELIVERY_UNDOCUMENTED, which no markdown names. Hint: add it to the knobs table in docs/onboarding.md.

title: No condition that never varies
rule: No assertion or branch tests a value that cannot change.
fix: Delete the condition, or test a value that can change.
example: scripts/x.ts:1 if(1 === 1) has a condition that never varies. Hint: delete it, or test a value that can change.
mistake: A check that cannot fail

title: Changed skills carry a matching eval stamp
rule: A skill that changed against the base ref has an eval stamp for its current content.
fix: Run node scripts/eval/changed-skills.ts --static for the skill, and commit its stamp file.
example: skill alpha has no stamp. Hint: skill alpha changed since its evals last passed; run node scripts/eval/changed-skills.ts --static alpha (no model run) or the live run, and commit evals/results/alpha.json
mistake: Behavior change without evidence

title: Plugin manifest pins no version
rule: The plugin manifest carries no version field, so every commit is a new version.
fix: Delete the version field.
example: plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json carries a version. A pinned version freezes installed copies until someone changes it. Hint: delete the "version" field; users then get every commit.
mistake: A change that never reaches installs

title: Shipped plugin code imports no TypeScript
rule: No file under plugin/ imports a .ts, .mts or .cts file.
fix: Import a .mjs file instead, because shipped code runs without a build.
example: plugin/hooks/h.mjs must not import TypeScript (import "./a.ts"). Hint: import a .mjs file instead, since shipped plugin code is plain JavaScript that runs without a build.
mistake: A dev-only file reached shipped code

title: Cursor config points at real files
rule: Cursor hooks name existing scripts, the shell guard fails closed, and rule files are .mdc files that point at AGENTS.md.
fix: Point the hook at a real script, set failClosed to true, or rename the rule file.
example: .cursor/hooks.json: beforeShellExecution runs gone.mjs, which does not exist. Hint: point the hook at a real script or remove it.
mistake: Config drift from the files it names

title: Check numbers are unique and contiguous
rule: The numbered sections of consistency.ts run from 1 with no gap and no repeat.
fix: Renumber the later section so the numbers run from 1 with no gap.
example: scripts/audit/consistency.ts must not repeat check number 1, but numbers 2 checks 1. Hint: renumber the later one, since two branches added a check at once.
mistake: Two branches claiming the same number

title: tsc keeps its strict flags
rule: tsconfig.json sets strict, checkJs, noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters to true.
fix: Turn the flag back on and fix the code that it reports.
example: tsconfig.json must set compilerOptions.noUnusedLocals to true, got false. Hint: fix the code the flag reports instead of turning the flag off.
mistake: Dead code nobody was told about

title: Repository carries a linked license
rule: LICENSE exists and is not empty, and the README links it.
fix: Add the license text and link it from the README.
example: LICENSE is missing or empty. Hint: add the license text; without one nobody may reuse the code.
mistake: Code that looks open but is not

title: README states true stamp counts
rule: The README states how many skill stamps are live, static and waived, and the numbers match evals/results.
fix: Update the README line whenever a stamp changes.
example: README.md has no "**L live, S static, W waived** of N skill stamps" line, and evals/results holds 1 live, 0 static, 0 waived of 1 skill stamps. Hint: write the numbers so a reader sees the eval status.
mistake: A status a reader cannot trust

title: Only allow-listed agents pin a model
rule: Only allow-listed agents pin a model, and each pins the value that the list names.
fix: Delete the model line from the agent.
example: agent "bot" pins model "opus", but is not allowed to pin one. Hint: pin a model only on the scout, since every other agent inherits the session model.
mistake: An agent pinning a model against policy

title: Inventoried rules stay in their files
rule: Every rule anchor stays in its file, every marker line is covered, and no long file has zero rules.
fix: Restore the deleted rule line, or update the anchor in the inventory.
example: evals/rules/skill-alpha.json: anchor "Auto-merge PRs" is in none of plugin/skills/alpha/SKILL.md. Hint: the rule line was deleted or reworded; restore it or update the anchor.
mistake: A load-bearing rule deleted by a trim

title: Instruction files stay within token budget
rule: Each instruction file has an entry in evals/token-budget.json and stays within it.
fix: Trim the text, or raise the budget in a pull request that says why.
example: plugin/skills/alpha/SKILL.md grew to 1014 estimated tokens, over its budget of 1013. Hint: trim the text, or raise the budget in evals/token-budget.json in a PR that says why.
mistake: Cost that grows unseen

title: Audit workflow keeps one matrix job
rule: One matrix job runs the consistency guard under the check names that branch protection requires.
fix: Keep one job and give each Node version a matrix entry.
example: .github/workflows/audit.yml: 2 jobs run node scripts/audit/consistency.ts ("consistency", "node-26"). Rule: one job runs it on every Node version through a matrix, so the copies cannot drift. Fix: keep one job and give each Node version a matrix entry.
mistake: A copy that drifts from its original

title: Live tests need an explicit opt-in
rule: A test that starts claude -p or runs a mutating gh command sources its opt-in guard first.
fix: Source the opt-in guard file above the first live call.
example: tests/live.test.sh: line 2 launches claude -p without the opt-in guard before it. Rule: a test that starts a real session on the subscription refuses to run unless GATED_DELIVERY_ALLOW_LIVE_CLAUDE=1, so the guard must come first; fix: add `source "$(dirname "$0")/require-live-opt-in.sh"` above the first call.
mistake: A costly action with no opt-in

title: Node floor stays in security support
rule: The Node floor in package.json is not at end of life, and every document names the same floor.
fix: Raise engines.node to a supported release, and update the documents.
example: README.md says "Node 18 or later" but package.json sets the floor to Node 22. Hint: make the document and engines.node name the same release.

title: Failure messages stay actionable
rule: A failure message names a value, states the rule and gives a fix, and the baseline never grows.
fix: Rewrite the message, then run message-actionability.ts with --update-baseline.
example: plugin/scripts/a.mjs must not hold the non-actionable message "something went wrong here"; rewrite it to name the value, state the rule and give a fix after ";".

title: Docs keep sentences short
rule: Each document keeps at least 80 percent of its sentences within 20 words.
fix: Split the longest sentences that the message lists.
example: docs/long.md has 0% of its 1 sentences within 20 words, below the 80% ASD-STE100 rule. Hint: split each long sentence, longest first: line 1 (30 words) "This sentence is deliberately made much...".
mistake: Prose that nobody can read quickly

title: Site has sources and the README links it
rule: The site build script and sources exist, and the README links the site URL.
fix: Restore the build script or the sources, or link the site URL from the README.
example: scripts/site/build.ts is missing. Rule: the README links a site that this script builds. Fix: restore the script.
mistake: Documentation that drifts from the repo

title: Writing tic list lives in one script
rule: Only prose-scan.mjs holds the tic list, and no file under plugin/ or evals/ repeats it as an alternation.
fix: Delete the copy and call prose-scan.mjs instead.
example: plugin/skills/alpha/SKILL.md:8 lists the tic phrases "worth noting" and "honestly" as a regex alternation, but the tic list must live only in plugin/skills/prose-writing/scripts/prose-scan.mjs. Hint: delete the copy and call the script.

title: Comments tell no history
rule: A comment in plugin/, scripts/ or tests/ states a constraint and never retells a change.
fix: Rewrite the comment in the present tense, or delete it.
example: plugin/hooks/h.mjs:1: rule temporal-contrast: "Until now nothing ran those fences.". Hint: delete the before-and-after contrast, or restate what the code does now; a comment states a constraint the code cannot show, in the present tense
mistake: History written into a comment

title: Suppressions carry a coded reason
rule: Every lint, type or coverage suppression has a reason, and the total equals suppressions.count.
fix: Add a reason of four or more meaningful words, or remove the suppression.
example: src/a.mjs:1: eslint suppression has no reason; write <marker> -- <reason of at least 4 distinct meaningful words>
mistake: A silent suppression

title: JSDoc holds type tags only
rule: A JSDoc block in a shipped .mjs file holds only type tags.
fix: Delete the prose, or move its meaning into a name.
example: plugin/a.mjs:2: prose in a JSDoc block, only type tags are allowed: "Does a thing."
mistake: Prose smuggled into a type comment

title: Every assertion is made to fail
rule: Some test makes each assert in non-test code false, or the baseline lists it.
fix: Add a test that makes the assertion fail, or delete the assertion.
example: (b) never false shout:3  typeof text === "string"  [1 evaluations]
mistake: An assertion that cannot fail

title: Site builds in CI and deploys
rule: A repository with site sources has a build script, a CI step and a deploy workflow.
fix: Restore the build script, the audit step or the site workflow.
example: scripts/site/build.ts is missing, but docs-site-src/ holds the site sources. Rule: the sources always have a generator. Fix: restore the script, or remove docs-site-src/.
